description: A fast fuzzy finder for the command line written in Rust

option.name: --version
tip: Print version.

global_option.name: --algo
tip: Fuzzy matching algorithm.

next.name: arinae
tip: Arinae: typo-resistant and natural algorithm, default.

next.name: clangd
tip: Clangd fuzzy matching algorithm.

next.name: frizbee
tip: Frizbee matching algorithm, typo resistant.

next.name: fzy
tip: Fzy matching algorithm.

next.name: skim_v2
tip: Previous skim fuzzy matching algorithm (v2).

global_option.name: --ansi
tip: Parse ANSI color codes in input strings.

global_option.name: --bind
tip: Comma-separated key, event, and action bindings.

global_option.name: --border
tip: Draw borders around the UI components.

global_option.name: --border-no-collapse
tip: Do not collapse adjacent borders into a shared row or column.

global_option.name: --case
tip: Case sensitivity.

next.name: ignore
tip: Case-insensitive matching.

next.name: respect
tip: Case-sensitive matching.

next.name: smart
tip: Smart case: case-insensitive unless query contains uppercase.

global_option.name: --cmd
tip: Command to invoke dynamically in interactive mode.

global_option.name: --cmd-history
tip: Command history file for interactive mode queries.

global_option.name: --cmd-history-size
tip: Maximum number of command history entries to keep.

global_option.name: --cmd-prompt
tip: Set prompt in command mode.

global_option.name: --cmd-query
tip: Initial query in interactive mode.

global_option.name: --color
tip: Set color theme, optionally with per-element overrides.

global_option.name: --cycle
tip: Cycle the results by wrapping around when scrolling.

global_option.name: --delimiter
tip: Delimiter between fields, in regex format.

global_option.name: --disable-pattern
tip: Disable items based on this regex pattern.

global_option.name: --disabled
tip: Disable matching entirely.

global_option.name: --exact
tip: Run in exact mode.

global_option.name: --exit-0
tip: Do not enter TUI if the query matches no item.

global_option.name: --expect
tip: Deprecated, kept for compatibility. See accept() bind instead.

global_option.name: --filter
tip: Query for filter mode, print matches and exit.

global_option.name: --header
tip: Set header, displayed next to the info.

global_option.name: --header-lines
tip: Number of lines of the input treated as header.

global_option.name: --height
tip: Height of skim's window, as a row count or percentage.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Print help (see more with '--help').

global_option.name: --hide-nth
tip: Fields to hide from display while keeping them searchable.

global_option.name: --highlight-line
tip: Highlight the entire current line, not just the text.

global_option.name: --history
tip: History file for search queries.

global_option.name: --history-size
tip: Maximum number of query history entries to keep.

global_option.name: --image
tip: Enable image preview.

next.name: detect
tip: Automatically detect the available backend at startup.

next.name: halfblocks
tip: Force halfblocks rendering for faster startup.

global_option.name: --info
tip: Set matching result count display position.

global_option.name: --inline-info
tip: Alias for --info=inline.

global_option.name: --interactive
tip: Start skim in interactive mode.

global_option.name: --keep-right
tip: Keep the right end of the line visible on overflow.

global_option.name: --last-match
tip: Highlight the last match found, not the first one.

global_option.name: --layout
tip: Set layout.

next.name: default
tip: Display from the bottom of the screen.

next.name: reverse
tip: Display from the top of the screen.

next.name: reverse-list
tip: Display from the top of the screen, prompt at the bottom.

global_option.name: --listen
tip: Run an IPC socket with optional name.

global_option.name: --log-file
tip: Pipe log output to a file.

global_option.name: --log-level
tip: Set the log level.

global_option.name: --man
tip: Generate man page and output it to stdout.

global_option.name: --margin
tip: Screen margin, as row counts or percentages.

global_option.name: --min-height
tip: Minimum height of skim's window as a non-negative row count.

global_option.name: --min-query-length
tip: Minimum query length to start showing results.

global_option.name: --multi
tip: Enable multiple selection.

global_option.name: --multi-selector
tip: Set multi-selected item icon.

global_option.name: --multiline
tip: Split item text into multiple display lines at the given separator.

global_option.name: --no-border
tip: Disables all borders, including in tmux/zellij popups.

global_option.name: --no-clear
tip: Do not clear screen on exit.

global_option.name: --no-clear-if-empty
tip: Do not clear previous items if the new command returns empty result.

global_option.name: --no-clear-start
tip: Do not clear items on start.

global_option.name: --no-height
tip: Disable height (force full screen).

global_option.name: --no-hscroll
tip: Disable horizontal scroll.

global_option.name: --no-info
tip: Alias for --info=hidden.

global_option.name: --no-mouse
tip: Disable mouse.

global_option.name: --no-multi
tip: Disable multiple selection.

global_option.name: --no-scrollbar
tip: Disable the scrollbar in the item list.

global_option.name: --no-sort
tip: Do not sort the results.

global_option.name: --no-strip-ansi
tip: Print ANSI codes so output exactly matches the input.

global_option.name: --no-typos
tip: Disable typo-tolerant matching.

global_option.name: --normalize
tip: Normalize unicode characters such as accents and diacritics.

global_option.name: --nth
tip: Fields to be matched, as comma-separated field index expressions.

global_option.name: --output-format
tip: Set the output format, overriding all print options.

global_option.name: --popup
tip: Run in a tmux or zellij popup.

global_option.name: --pre-select-file
tip: Pre-select the items read from this file.

global_option.name: --pre-select-items
tip: Pre-select the items separated by newline character.

global_option.name: --pre-select-n
tip: Pre-select the first n items in multi-selection mode.

global_option.name: --pre-select-pat
tip: Pre-select the matched items in multi-selection mode.

global_option.name: --preview
tip: Preview command for the current line.

global_option.name: --preview-window
tip: Preview window layout.

global_option.name: --print-cmd
tip: Print the command as the first line (after print-query).

global_option.name: --print-current
tip: Print the current highlighted item as the first line.

global_option.name: --print-header
tip: Print the header as the first line (after print-score).

global_option.name: --print-query
tip: Print the query as the first line.

global_option.name: --print-score
tip: Print the score after each item.

global_option.name: --print0
tip: Print output delimited by ASCII NUL characters.

global_option.name: --prompt
tip: Set prompt.

global_option.name: --query
tip: Initial query.

global_option.name: --read0
tip: Read input delimited by ASCII NUL characters.

global_option.name: --regex
tip: Start in regex mode instead of fuzzy-match.

global_option.name: --remote
tip: Send commands to an IPC socket with optional name.

global_option.name: --reverse
tip: Shorthand for reverse layout.

global_option.name: --scheme
tip: Matching scheme preset.

next.name: default
tip: Default scheme, no modifications to the options.

next.name: history
tip: History scheme: force index as the first tiebreak.

next.name: path
tip: Path scheme: find the furthest match, prefer pathname tiebreak.

global_option.name: --scrollbar
tip: Set scrollbar style for the item list.

global_option.name: --select-1
tip: Do not enter TUI if the query matches only one item.

global_option.name: --selector
tip: Set selected item icon.

global_option.name: --shell
tip: Generate shell completion script.

next.name: bash
tip: Bourne Again SHell.

next.name: elvish
tip: Elvish shell.

next.name: fish
tip: Friendly Interactive SHell.

next.name: nushell
tip: Nushell (nu).

next.name: power-shell
tip: PowerShell.

next.name: zsh
tip: Zsh.

global_option.name: --shell-bindings
tip: Generate shell key bindings, only for bash, zsh and fish.

global_option.name: --show-cmd-error
tip: Show error message if command fails.

global_option.name: --skip-to-pattern
tip: Show the matched pattern at the line start.

global_option.name: --split-match
tip: Enable split matching with an optional delimiter.

global_option.name: --sync
tip: Synchronous search for multi-staged filtering.

global_option.name: --tabstop
tip: Number of spaces that make up a tab.

global_option.name: --tac
tip: Show results in reverse order.

global_option.name: --tiebreak
tip: Comma-separated sort criteria applied when scores are tied.

global_option.name: --typos
tip: Enable typo-tolerant matching, optionally with max allowed typos.

global_option.name: --with-nth
tip: Fields to be transformed, see nth for the details.

global_option.name: --wrap
tip: Wrap items in the item list.

global_option.name: -I
tip: Replace replstr with the selected item in commands.
